dish_en: Portuguese-style baked egg tarts, shared at a family afternoon tea
product_desc: baked egg tarts in fluted foil cups packed close on a dark tray, the custard deep yellow and glossy with dark caramelised blisters across the top, the pastry rims in visible flaky layers, one tart broken open in a hand to show the pale set custard inside, no packaging anywhere in frame
cook: a parent in their thirties in comfortable home clothes, sleeves pushed up, warm and unhurried
cook2: their young child, about six, standing safely back from the counter with both hands on its edge, watching
kitchen: a bright family kitchen with pale counters, a built-in oven at counter height, a fridge to one side, and warm light from a window on the left
prep_subject: chilled egg tarts in fluted foil cups arranged in even rows on a dark baking tray lined with parchment, spaced so they do not touch, the custard still pale and matt and the pastry rims still raw. A pair of oven mitts lies folded at the far side of the tray
prep_defines: the tart count, the foil cups and the spacing on the tray
cook_vessel: a dark baking tray on the middle rack of a lit oven
cook_subject: the tarts partway through baking, the custard risen and shining and just beginning to blister dark at the centre, the pastry rims puffed into visible layers and going gold. Warm amber oven light and visible heat haze, the tray sitting square on the middle rack
cook_negatives: raw pale custard, burnt black tops, soggy collapsed pastry, tarts touching or overflowing their cups, a child anywhere near the open oven
hero_subject: the finished tarts on a white plate at the table, custard deep yellow and glossy with dark caramelised blisters, pastry rims crisp and layered, a small jug of milk and two cups of tea beside the plate
hero_setting: a warm family table in the same home, afternoon window light, the child seated at the near side
story: the tray of tarts goes into the hot oven
the custard sets and blisters and the pastry goes golden
onto the plate at the table, one tart lifted and broken open
negatives_global: bakery display case, commercial kitchen, cream-piped tarts, fruit-topped tarts, raw pale custard, burnt black tops, plastic packaging, sealed tray, product label, printed nutrition panel, barcode
first_heat: The tray settles square on the rack and the oven light catches the row of pale custard tops, the nearest of them already beginning to shine as the heat reaches them.
clip01_shot3: [Shot 3] At 00:03.400, the shot cuts to a locked-off close-up at oven height. The open oven of <Picture 3> fills the frame, warm amber light spilling out of it, the empty middle rack waiting. The hands of <Subject 1>, in oven mitts, enter from the bottom of frame carrying the loaded tray level, slide it onto the middle rack in one continuous movement until it is fully home, and withdraw straight down out of frame empty. The tray settles square on the rack and the oven light catches the row of pale custard tops. <Subject 2> stays well back at the edge of frame, never reaching toward the oven. The camera does not move at any point in this shot.
clip02_shot1: [Shot 1] Locked-off close-up at oven height, 50mm feel, continuing directly from <Picture 1>. The tray of <Picture 4> fills the lower two thirds of frame on the middle rack of the lit oven, the heat source glowing at the bottom of frame throughout. The tarts placed in clip 01 are already rising, the custard losing its matt surface and starting to shine. A mitted hand of <Subject 1> enters from the top of frame, takes the near edge of the tray, turns it half a rotation so the far row comes forward, and withdraws straight up out of frame empty. The tray settles square again and the newly turned row sits closest to camera, its custard visibly further along than the row that has just gone back. The camera does not move at any point in this shot, and the framing does not drift.
transform: the custard rises and sets from matt pale yellow to a glossy deep yellow, dark caramelised blisters bloom across the tops one after another, and the pastry rims puff apart into visible flaky layers and turn gold.
lift: A mitted hand and a palette knife enter from the left, slide under one tart, lift it clear of the tray and hold it at the centre of frame. The custard is deep yellow and blistered dark, the foil cup fluted and bright, steam lifting from the surface.
plate: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame with a palette knife, lift the tarts from the tray one at a time and set them onto the plate in a close ring until it is full, then withdraw straight up out of frame empty.
cook2_close: <Subject 2> is seated at the near side of the table, hands flat on the wood, waiting.
final_lift: A hand enters from the right, takes one tart by its foil cup, lifts it clear of the plate and breaks it open at the centre of frame, the pastry parting into flaky layers and the pale set custard showing inside, steam rising from the break.
cook2_open: <Subject 2> stands back at the edge of frame with both hands on the counter, watching and not reaching.
sound_01: A quiet family home with a low room tone. In the first shot, a fridge door seal releasing and a drawer rolling out on its runners. In the second shot, foil cups being set down one by one on a metal tray. In the third shot, an oven door swinging open with a warm rush of air, and the tray sliding home against the rack. No speech, no music from within the room.
sound_02: A low oven hum throughout with a faint crackle of pastry. In the first shot, a tray turning against the rack with a short metallic scrape. In the second shot, the hum alone as the custard sets, the crackle sharpening. In the third shot, a palette knife going under a tart and lifting it free. No speech.
sound_03: A quiet home with soft afternoon room tone. In the first shot, foil cups touching down against a ceramic plate one after another. In the second shot, a plate sliding a short way across a wooden table. In the third shot, flaky pastry tearing open, and a teacup settling in its saucer. No speech.
music: A warm domestic bed: a simple piano melody over light sustained strings, gentle and lilting, the feeling of a slow afternoon at home with nothing else scheduled.
